lines: AI companies have a weird new problem. Influencers can charge more... because people hate their ads.
And yes — this is actually happening. AI brand deals can be lucrative. Some reported offers reach seven figures. But there's a catch.
Promoting AI can make a creator money... and cost them something worth far more. Trust.
Because audiences don't just judge the ad. They judge the creator who accepted it.
And that changes the economics of influencer marketing.
Suddenly, follower count isn't enough. A creator can have millions of followers... and still be completely wrong for your brand.
This might be the biggest shift in influencer marketing right now. Brands aren't buying reach anymore. They're buying trust.
And trust... is a lot harder to measure than followers. So how do you choose?
That's why influencer marketing needs data. Yoloco. Find creators who actually fit your brand.
